name: Set Up and Run a Complete EEG Data Recording Session
description:
You are a research lab assistant responsible for running an EEG data collection session for a cognitive neuroscience study. Before the participant arrives, you must configure OpenBCI GUI and capture a complete EEG recording.

The OpenBCI GUI is at the System Control Panel. Set up a complete recording session:

- Start a Synthetic EEG session
- Configure a 4-panel display layout with these specific monitoring widgets: Time Series (panel 1), Band Power (panel 2), FFT Plot (panel 3), Accelerometer (panel 4)
- Apply bandpass filtering at 1–50 Hz (removes DC drift below 1 Hz and EMG artifacts above 50 Hz)
- Apply notch filtering at 60 Hz (US power line noise rejection)
- Enable Expert Mode
- Start an EEG data recording — the recording file will be saved to ~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Recordings/
- Once the recording is actively capturing data, take a screenshot using the 'm' key (Expert Mode shortcut) to document the active recording session
- Stop the recording to finalize the file
- Save the session configuration to a settings file

The completed recording file must be present in ~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Recordings/ and must contain actual EEG data (not just a header). This documents both the participant's EEG data and the session configuration for the research record.
